summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as DHCP server on its private eth1/lan2 interface (10.200.20.0/24), which connects to node2 and node3's enp8s0 NICs. Added a static UCI dhcp host reservation binding node2's enp8s0 MAC to 10.200.20.50, while node3 draws from the general pool (10.200.20.100-150). Verified node2 consistently receives 10.200.20.50 across lease renewals and reboots, while node3 receives a distinct pool address (10.200.20.131) that also persists. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes sequentially (node1 first as router, then node2, then node3), each showing a changed boot_id and fully recovered DHCP/router state.
actions_performed: Inspected network topology on node1/node2/node3 (ip addr, ip route, uci show network) to identify eth1 (node1) / enp8s0 (node2, node3) as the shared private network
Created OpenWrt UCI interface 'lan2' on eth1 with static IP 10.200.20.1/24 on node1 and reloaded network service
Added eth1/lan2 to the existing 'lan' firewall zone via uci add_list and reloaded firewall
Configured UCI dhcp.lan2 dnsmasq server on lan2 with pool range .100-.150 (12h lease)
Added a static UCI dhcp host entry binding node2's enp8s0 MAC (02:D5:A3:66:24:7D) to 10.200.20.50, committed and restarted dnsmasq
Confirmed node2 and node3 already had systemd-networkd DHCP=yes configured for all en* interfaces, requiring no client-side changes
Triggered DHCP acquisition on node2/node3 enp8s0 and verified node2 got the reserved 10.200.20.50 and node3 got pool address 10.200.20.131
Verified reservation persistence via networkctl renew on node2 and cross-checked node1's /tmp/dhcp.leases
Captured baseline boot_id on all three nodes

Restarted node1 via 'reboot' (backgrounded with sleep since nohup unavailable on BusyBox), polled until exec access returned, confirmed new boot_id, verified eth1/dnsmasq/UCI config persisted, and confirmed node2/node3 DHCP leases survived the router restart
Restarted node2 via 'sudo reboot', polled until recovery, confirmed new boot_id and that enp8s0 reacquired reserved 10.200.20.50
Restarted node3 via 'sudo reboot', polled until recovery, confirmed new boot_id and that enp8s0 reacquired pool address 10.200.20.131
Final cross-check of node1's dnsmasq lease file showing both node2 (reserved) and node3 (pool) entries simultaneously present post all restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 hands out DHCP addresses on the private network shared with node2/node3
evidence.summary: eth1/lan2 configured with static 10.200.20.1/24, added to lan firewall zone, dnsmasq DHCP server configured and confirmed running/listening on UDP 67

evidence.requirement: node2 always receives the same address (10.200.20.50) across repeated leases
evidence.summary: node2's enp8s0 received 10.200.20.50 initially, kept it after networkctl renew, and again after a full node2 reboot and node1 reboot; node1's lease file confirms the binding

evidence.requirement: node3 is addressed from the general DHCP pool (distinct from node2's reserved address)
evidence.summary: node3's enp8s0 received pool address 10.200.20.131 (within .100-.150 range, not the reserved .50) and retained it after its own reboot and node1's reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 252ee74a captured; reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id 156b99bf-8ca6 (changed) with uptime ~8s; eth1 IP, dnsmasq, and UCI DHCP host config all recovered; node2 successfully renewed its reserved lease afterward, proving DHCP service fully functional

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 96c08b66 captured (matches earlier baseline); reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id b3733f3b-f873 (changed) with uptime ~6s; enp8s0 reacquired its reserved DHCP address 10.200.20.50

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bfd05127 captured (matches earlier baseline); reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id 465bfe67-d93e (changed) with uptime ~3s; enp8s0 reacquired its general-pool DHCP address 10.200.20.131
